doc.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019

title: Whether musicians were conscious of their place in history
summary: Rowe suggests players don't think of history; Schoenberg names those who did.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: Well don’t you usually think that, usually explaining things and putting them in context historical and otherwise is usually left to the people who are not doing it. The people that are doing it think less about where is my work fitting in to the timeline and the whole development thing. They’re doing it because they’re driven, and then years later it will get sorted out but not by them but by somebody else.
Yeah. Well some of them were very conscious of it and some of them did see it all.
John Lewis, Benny Carter, Duke Ellington for starters, Dizzy Gillespie, Max Roach, Wynton Marsalis.
